name: Safari Garden 2
description: Sixteen more wild friends among big flowers: a bear cub, a panda, a koala, a kangaroo, a camel, a crocodile, a sloth, a lemur, a peacock, a red panda, a tree frog, an okapi, an armadillo, a butterfly, a fennec fox and a warthog.
style: Children's coloring book page, square 1:1. Pure white background with a wide empty white margin on all sides; nothing touches the edges. Bold uniform thick black outlines, same weight everywhere. No shading, no grey, no texture, no fur, no hatching, no black fills except tiny eye dots, no text, no border frame. Every shape fully closed. One large friendly wild animal, centered, in a simple garden with big flowers and leaves. About 16 large closed areas to color. Eyes are small solid black dots, smile is one short line. Nothing scary, no teeth, no claws. Very simple, cute, for a 3-year-old.

pages.name: Bear Cub
pages.subject: a whole round bear cub sitting, seen from the front, with round ears, a pale muzzle, a big belly patch and round paws, beside two big flowers and leaves. No background panel, no frame

pages.name: Panda Bamboo
pages.subject: a round panda sitting and holding a thick bamboo stalk with wide leaves, with separate dark ear, eye and arm patches as closed shapes

pages.name: Koala Hug
pages.subject: a koala with big round ears hugging a thick tree branch with a few wide leaves

pages.name: Kangaroo Pouch
pages.subject: a mother kangaroo standing with a baby joey peeking out of her pouch, beside a round bush

pages.name: Camel Dunes
pages.subject: a smiling camel with two round humps and a striped blanket, walking past a round cactus with one big flower

pages.name: Crocodile Grin
pages.subject: a friendly crocodile lying down with its mouth closed and no teeth, a back of wide rounded bumps, beside a pond with a lily pad

pages.name: Sloth Hang
pages.subject: a sleepy sloth hanging upside down from one thick branch by its arms, with a pale face mask and big eye patches and a flower tucked behind its ear, two big leaves on the branch. Floating on plain white, no background panel, no sky, no square frame

pages.name: Lemur Tail
pages.subject: a ring-tailed lemur sitting on a rock with a long curled tail of a few very wide stripes

pages.name: Peacock Fan
pages.subject: a peacock with a big round fan tail of wide feather shapes, each with one big round eye spot, like a mandala

pages.name: Red Panda Nap
pages.subject: a red panda lying asleep along one thick smooth branch, very few shapes: round head with two ears and a pale face patch, a body, two legs, and a tail of only four wide rings. One big flower and two big leaves on the branch. No fur tufts, no small details

pages.name: Tree Frog Leaf
pages.subject: a smiling tree frog with big round toes sitting on one huge leaf, beside a big flower

pages.name: Okapi Stripes
pages.subject: a gentle okapi with big ears and wide stripes only on its legs, standing among tall leaves

pages.name: Armadillo Roll
pages.subject: a smiling armadillo standing on a small grassy mound, with a shell of four very wide bands, a rounded snout and big ears, beside three daisies. Floating on plain white, no background panel, no sky, no square frame

pages.name: Butterfly Bloom
pages.subject: one big butterfly with four wide wings, each with one big round spot, resting on a large flower

pages.name: Fennec Fox
pages.subject: a fennec fox with very big ears and a fluffy tail, sitting beside a round cactus flower and a sun

pages.name: Warthog Puddle
pages.subject: a cheerful round warthog with short rounded tusks and a tufty mane, standing in a round mud puddle beside flowers
